text: If PaymentMethod is CHK, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction is optional. If PaymentMethod is different from CHK, then CreditTransferTransactionInformation/ChequeInstruction is not allowed. Rule rationale: ChequeInstructionDetails may be present if the payment method is Cheque. It must not be present if the payment method is 'Transfer'.
reading: if PaymentMethod is not CHK, no CreditTransferTransactionInformation has ChequeInstruction
